name: Save drops unplayable records
description: Save cave: acquires the lock, snapshots the live chord bank to a staging buffer at 0x1000E500, releases the lock, then sanitises and writes the snapshot. This prevents a concurrent publish from changing the bank between the ownership check and f_write (save-race fix). Sanitising first means a record whose step note is not among its notes is never persisted, since the fan-out could never fire it. Saving to a chosen letter is how the module copies a pattern, so the bank is written even when its owner is a different letter; the frame letter must still match the block the resolver found, which keeps a save from crossing tracks.
